'''Corran Antillies Yet another Court of the Vile Mandolarian''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Corran Antillies]]
* '''Published:''' 15 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / Vile Gangsters|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Strategy:''' Court Of The Vile Gangster
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Vile Antillies DS 2003 Yetanoth.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Another version of my court deck.  It's getting better.  I finally added scum.  It still needs help though

The published list has 58 cards.

== Strategy ==

Start the stuff, and pull all the stuff you can.  You get out your sites really fast, and can pull lots of characters.  Capture them and feed them to the sarlaac.  if you get in a drain war, then put ev9d9 in the droid shop with all the droids.  If you're facing a space deck, before the drain war, throw down all you're indy ships from reserve deck as fast as possible.  on ground, you shouldn't have any problem at all dominating.  finally, Bane Maler is really cool.  Look him up at decipher if u've never heard of him.  I hadn't until I got him in my JPSD the other day.

***I still need Scum and villainy, Power of the Hutt(it somehow didn't show up in my JPSD), and Neimoidian advisor x3.

Email me if you have ANY of them at khalman2000@hotmail.com
